summary: Flew home from Paris on arrival after leaving a child at home
story: We flew from Chicago to Paris on June 20 as a family of six. Somewhere over the Atlantic I realized that our youngest son, Kevin, who is eight, was not on the plane. We had overslept, we left for the airport in a rush and the head count in the van was wrong. I took the first available flight home the moment we landed in Paris. Kevin was fine. In his words, he had handled it. I am claiming my one-way fare home and my share of the prepaid hotel nights in Paris that I did not use.
